description: The phone apps: the device link inside the app, with the desktop link's three commands (mobile plan M3-1, MOB-031), and the sign-in to the Anima.ing account with the cloud commands of the desktop app but `cloud_device` (mobile plan M3-4; HMD-032 to HMD-035, HMD-043). On an iPhone the sign-in page shows inside the app, in the web authentication session of iOS (`cloud_sign_in_session`, mobile plan M3-5; no argument, and the code and the tokens stay in the shell). On Android the page of the sign-in opens in the browser of the phone; the shell takes only an https address. The WorkOS tokens and the device code never reach the web view. Main web view only.
